items.title: Rainfall can travel from mountain slopes to rivers far faster than expected in mountain catchments
items.summary: Researchers at University of Tsukuba have found that river responses to rainfall can reach rivers and appear as runoff much more rapidly than previously assumed in mountainous regions. The findings provide new insights into runoff generation and flood development in mountainous regions. The paper is published in the Journal of Hydrology.
